title.en: Move your tabs without a restart.

introduction.en: Tab bars, permission prompts and agent approvals stay usable as your setup changes.
introduction.fr: Les barres d’onglets, les autorisations et les accès des agents suivent vos changements de configuration.

body.en: Moving tabs to another edge no longer freezes the tab bar. Permission prompts from the address toolbar open into the page, where you can reach them.
body.fr: Déplacer les onglets sur un autre bord ne fige plus leur barre. Les demandes d’autorisation de la barre d’adresse s’ouvrent dans la page et restent accessibles.

notes: Moving the tabs to another edge no longer leaves the tab bar frozen or unclickable until Lilo restarts.
A permission prompt opened from the address above the page hangs down into the page instead of rising off the top of the window.
